items.title: Brokers risk losing digital asset clients by delaying specialist advice
items.summary: Brokers handling clients with cryptocurrency assets must establish custody structures early or risk coverage gaps and client churn, according to industry experts.

items.title: ABI and Surviving Economic Abuse highlight financial product risks
items.summary: Insurance and pension firms are reviewing customer processes and staff training to help prevent the misuse of financial products in economic abuse cases.

items.title: LIIBA warns geopolitical instability and AI risks could reshape 2027 insurance outlook
items.summary: Christopher Croft of LIIBA has warned that geopolitical friction, economic pressures and artificial intelligence risks may challenge softening insurance market conditions in 2027.

items.title: DWP confirms pre-1997 indexation for PPF and FAS members from January
items.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions has confirmed that Pension Protection Fund and Financial Assistance Scheme members will receive inflation-linked increases capped at 2.5% on pre-1997 pensions from January 2027.

items.title: Industry calls for greater transparency from private markets managers
items.summary: Think tank City Hive has urged investors to address disclosure gaps regarding corporate culture and governance among private markets managers.

items.title: APP fraud losses climb 22% to £316m as payment scams rise
items.summary: UK Finance reports that authorised push payment fraud losses reached £316 million in the first half of 2026, driven by an increase in persuasion-based scams.
